## Production ShopMate v4.2.6

- Pure WebAssembly SQLite (sql.js) engine with zero native compilation dependencies.
- Dedicated Production & Manufacturing Module with Custom Batch (Mode A) and BOM Backflush (Mode B).
- Dedicated Industrial Catalog, Material Enrollment (Single, Bulk Grid, CSV), and Factory Parties (Suppliers & Contractors).
- Factory Stock & WIP Valuation (Raw Material 1040, Packaging 1041, WIP 1042, Finished Goods 1043).
- High-performance minified and mangled production build.
